message.content:
This week's practice plan for learner LR-2024-0881 should focus on reinforcing factorising quadratics and minimizing sign errors. As LR-2024-0881 has an accommodation for extra time on all assessments and no timed drills, **timed drills should be avoided**.

The practice should include a mix of exercises on factorising quadratics, with a specific emphasis on identifying and correcting sign errors. Incorporate strategies that help the learner double-check their work for sign mistakes, such as writing out each step carefully or using a different color pen for signs. Since attendance has been good and homework is submitted on time, continue with regular practice sets, ensuring they include a variety of quadratic factorisation problems.
